risks.description: Template marketplaces becoming oversaturated with similar products
risks.mitigation: Focus on hyper-specific professional niches. Bundle templates with implementation guides.

risks.description: Platform algorithm changes could reduce content reach and client ROI
risks.mitigation: Track performance metrics across platforms. Build multi-platform distribution strategy.
Develop template-based workflows. Consider hiring freelancers for editing overflow.

risks.description: AI regulations and standards are still evolving rapidly
risks.mitigation: Stay current with EU AI Act and other frameworks. Build flexible audit methodologies.

risks.description: Liability concerns for providing audit opinions
risks.mitigation: Work under professional insurance. Frame deliverables as recommendations not certifications.

risks.description: Microsoft licensing and pricing changes affecting project economics
risks.mitigation: Build buffer into quotes. Stay updated on partner program changes.

risks.description: AWS service updates may require continuous retraining
risks.mitigation: Focus on well-established services. Use infrastructure-as-code for repeatability.

risks.description: Security misconfiguration could create liability exposure
risks.mitigation: Use AWS best practice templates. Conduct security reviews before handoff.

risks.description: Google Business Profile guideline changes affecting optimization tactics
risks.mitigation: Focus on fundamentals (NAP consistency, reviews). Monitor policy updates regularly.

risks.description: Product-market fit unproven, may not gain traction
risks.mitigation: Start with MVP validation interviews. Pivot quickly based on user feedback.

risks.description: Payment processing integration complexity and compliance
risks.mitigation: Use Stripe or similar with PCI compliance built-in. Start with simple subscription model.
